name: Accordion Gallery

expand.description: flex-grow ratio of the expanded panel.

grayscale.description: Grayscale amount of a collapsed panel.

activeIndex.description: Panel expanded when nothing is hovered or focused; -1 for none.

stackBelow.description: Viewport width, in px, below which the layout stacks vertically. Can only lower the baked-in 640px default, never raise it.

a11y: Panels are list items and the links are the focus targets, so :focus-within expands the panel under keyboard focus.
Labels are real text and stay in the DOM, so screen readers read them even when the panel is collapsed.
The label sits on a gradient scrim with >= 4.5:1 contrast against white text.
The host's own focus outline is untouched.
